Ryan, saw Nextech shipped Cora Scribe and took home 2026 Best in KLAS for ophthalmology again.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market practices than the team can work before reps are stretched, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Ryan, quick follow-up for Nextech.

With new products live and the KLAS win driving interest, demand often outpaces coverage, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit target this quarter. So the gap shows up late, and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Ryan, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nextech's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
